issues.title: [Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan

en.headline: 9 own commits across three repositories; one issue opened
en.summary: The day included **9 own commits** across three repositories, plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, four own commits added three public-repository gates to collection, split attribution data into SHA and identity stages, re-fetched and re-rendered the full local 10-23 dataset after merging, and repaired missed personal commits using a SHA list. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, three own commits converted internal README links to absolute clickable URLs and adjusted site cards to equal height, sans-serif headings, orange interactions, and example boxes. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, two own commits required the user's global Git identity for commits and added Chrome built-in translation while splitting contributor documentation. The user opened issue #5489 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan"; it remains open with 1 comment. No pull requests, reviews, releases, discussions, replies, or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 9 次本人提交，新开 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 当天在三个仓库完成 **9 次本人提交**，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次本人提交为采集流程加入三道公开仓库闸门，将归属修正数据拆分为 SHA 与身份两段，合并后按本地完整数据重新获取并渲染 10-23 内容，并通过 SHA 名单修复漏计的本人提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 3 次本人提交将 README 内部文档链接改为绝对地址和可点击链接，并调整站点卡片为等高、无衬线标题、橙色交互与示例框。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 2 次本人提交要求提交使用用户的全局 Git 身份，并新增 Chrome 内置翻译及拆分贡献者文档。用户新开 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue #5489，标题为“[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan”；该 issue 仍为开放状态，含 1 条评论。未记录 pull request、评审、发布、讨论、回复或状态变更。
